listing.name: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild (nxport)
listing.summary: The nxport team is still working toward playable Breath of the Wild on Apple devices. The source builder can create a Mac or iOS app from your own extracted Switch game. There is no release package or confirmed playable game version.
listing.original_game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild

steps.title: Check your original game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own extracted ExeFS, RomFS and Logo. The project has not confirmed a supported game version, region or title ID.

steps.title: Follow the project’s setup
steps.instruction: Build nxport-builder from source, choose the Breath of the Wild profile and select Mac or iOS to produce a local app or IPA. You handle the resulting build and any updates.

references.title: Version and platform notes
references.instruction: The builder targets Apple silicon. There is no confirmed Windows or Linux player.
